title: ui(plugin-grid): in a record drawer, a related list's right-pinned action column (with an inline primary action) covers the Status column at rest
body:
Found by a downstream app on the published 18.4.0 packages (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm, the allocation-plan related list of an order).

## Symptom

An order opened in a **record drawer** (from its list, at 1440 / 1280 / 1024 px wide) shows its child related list with a right-pinned actions column. When a row action is promoted inline (a `variant: 'primary'` custom action, `maxInlineActions` 1), the pinned column is ~154 px and sits **over** the last data column (Status) at rest: `elementFromPoint` at the centre of the Status cell returns the action button, and the Status header is hidden too. Status is revealed only by scrolling the table's scroll box horizontally (753 / 623 px). On the order's full page at 1440 there is no overlap. At 390 px the list renders as cards and the action moves into each card's menu (fine).

## Producer (downstream reading, unverified by the PM seat beyond the file reads)

`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx` ~lines 337–343 (inline primary promotion, testid ~529) together with the grid's right-pinned actions column: the pinned column's width grows with the inline button but the scroll box does not reserve it, so a non-overflowing first view is partly covered.

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

Reserve the pinned column's width in the scroll box (or make the first view overflow-aware), so no data column is covered at rest; or fall back to the menu-only action column when the inline button would cover a data column.

Dedupe words: sticky action column overlaps status · right-pinned action column covers column · related list drawer inline primary.
